name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)

summary.oneLiner: A high-interest savings account for your daughter's future.
summary.whatIsIt: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana helps parents save for a girl child's education and marriage. If you have a daughter below 10 years old, you can open this account in her name. It offers a higher interest rate than most savings accounts, and the money you deposit gets tax benefits.

benefits.text: Higher interest rate than regular savings accounts, plus tax benefits on deposits

whoCanApply: You have a daughter under 10 years old

documents.name: Birth certificate of the girl child

howToApply.title: Choose a bank or post office
howToApply.detail: Sukanya Samriddhi accounts can be opened at most banks and post offices.

howToApply.title: Fill the account opening form
howToApply.detail: Submit the girl child's birth certificate and your identity proof.

howToApply.title: Deposit regularly
howToApply.detail: Deposit at least ₹250 a year to keep the account active until it reaches maturity.

rules.label: You have a daughter under 10 years old
rules.sourceQuote: A Sukanya Samriddhi Account may be opened by the natural or legal guardian in the name of a girl child from birth till she attains the age of 10 years.

jargon.meaning: The extra money the bank or post office adds to your savings over time.
The time when the account is complete and the money can be withdrawn.

documentGaps: The document does not clearly limit the scheme to two daughters per family here, though the official rules cap it at two (with an exception for twins or triplets).
